title: Review verdict (base)
description:
One schema for every reviewing role in every repository. Roles use different words for the same three states — ALLOW / ALLOW WITH CONDITIONS / REFUSE, APPROVE / CONDITIONAL / REJECT, PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCKED. `decision` is the canonical triple a grader reads; `decision_label` carries the role's own word so the Markdown and the JSON can be shown to agree. agents-md-schema.md rule 13.

BASE: `agent` and `scope_class` are left open and narrowed by the composing repository.

This file carries no `$id`: the bundle is vendored and every `$ref` into it is a relative path, so it resolves from the filesystem — on github.com, in CI without a network, and in a fresh clone alike. An `$id` would make the canonical identifier a URL that must then be fetched or registered.

agent.description: The reviewing role. Narrowed to the repository's own enum by the composing schema.

decision.description: PASS: nothing blocks a merge. CONDITIONAL: merges once the listed findings are addressed. BLOCKED: a hard rule or a scoped ban is violated.

decision_label.description: The word the role's Markdown response used, mapped onto `decision`.

scope_class.description: What kind of surface the change touches. The vocabulary is the repository's; ADR-085 §E.16 fixes it for pull requests, and a review may use a finer one.

findings.description: Empty for PASS. A finding that cannot name the clause it violates is a suggestion, and belongs in `suggestions`.

why.description: The clause violated, as `<file>#<rule>` — for example `adr-conventions.md#7` or `.agents/policies/the-wall.md#2`.

location.description: `<path>:<line>` where the finding is anchored, when it has one site.

suggestions.description: Improvements with no clause behind them. Never a reason to withhold PASS.

checks_run.description: Every mechanical check the role was supposed to run, including the ones that did not. A check reported as `not-run` is the point of this field: a verdict resting on an unrun check must say so (error-handling-and-fallback.md rule 1).

allOf.description: BLOCKED and CONDITIONAL both require at least one finding; a verdict short of PASS with an empty findings list is unactionable.
BLOCKED means at least one finding is itself blocking.
